My Blogging Workflow

by Joe Blogs

Where do you deploy your website? What's the process like?

I deploy my site to a vultr.com. I use their budget friendly 1vCPU/1Gb RAM linux virtual machine for $6.00 USD per month. I have a seperate blog post on how I use Caddy to serve local files from my machine to the internet.

I run make site-deploy and rsync the fresh copy to the remote.

What's your basic workflow for working on your website?

one (1) command line interface for managing content (CMS) and one (1) program for building the site.

Here is the steps to write a new blog post.

  1. (CMS) Create an entry (by default all new entries are marked as draft).
  2. (CMS) Update the entry (content and/or description and/or give it a featured image and/or toggle draft mode).
  3. (SSG) Build site in draft mode, preview the entry, go back step 1 else continue (* this can be frustrating).
  4. (SSG) Deploy by running make site-deploy.

Any features you really wish your generator had?

What are your biggest frustrations?

  • To be more technical - when I update an entry, I read it's contents into a temporary file on disk - and when I am done editing I then write the contents back to the DB. I would like it to write the db on file save so I don't have to reopen the file when previewing.
